measured_dependency: V19 slow path read_ptr[3] to current_valid crosses read selection, retire, capacity/step and global parser-fault gating. V20 first measures a pure known-eligibility shortcut; no pipeline changes yet.
candidate: Separate registered retire payload stage plus existing output hold stage, each one128-bit/16-byte mask beat; ring pointer frees a word only when its data/metadata is copied into the retirement stage. Stage drain/output may progress concurrently with next ring read; sustained one128-bitbeat perclock remains required.
latency_contract: Explicit +one internal retirement cycle after original eligible ring observation; compared by ordered transaction scoreboard and control/fault event relations, never by silently disabling old cycle miter. External valid/data/metadata stay stable under ready-low. Ring depth remains same; two owned register stages provide bounded additional holding capacity, whose overflow behavior must be specified explicitly.
protocol_invariants: Only slots with committed pointer coverage and resolved good verdict may enter retired stage; sampled data/metadata and eligibility from same old ring state. Same-edge incoming verdict/commit updates become visible on subsequent stagecapture, avoiding speculative release.

Read pointer advance and capture must be atomic; physical slot reuse allowed only after all corresponding bits/metadata are registered. Ring occupancy plus both stage validbits conserves accepted good bytes.

Reset, start, flush, abort and parser/header/buffer fault clear both validbits with declared existing priority. No uncommitted or previous epoch data can become externallyvalid after restart; copied invalid payload may differ but remains unobservable.

A legal output held during a later malformed packet requires explicit cancellation semantics matching public fault/epoch contract. Stage pipeline must not expose a beat on fault edge merely because it was copied earlier; valid gating and abort priority require independent review.

Pure zero-keep groups can be discarded on ringcapture without consuming payload stage when safe, or enter an emptytoken stage and drain unconditionally. In either case forward progress under a held valid output must be proved; V20 aligned55-retirement witness remains mandatory.

Combinational stage-ready path must not recreate ring payload/eligibility to step/fault/current_valid path. If full stage means no ringfree, continuous physical ingress still uses finitebuffer overflow/halt; no assumption of unlimited upstream backpressure.
required_tests: Separate new source from V11/V17/V19/V20; exact transformed cone inventory and deliberate latency specification.
Independent byte/event scoreboard at sustained minimum packets, maximum packets, allalignment/CRC/EDB/EDS cases, multiple ring and verdict-tagwraps.
Every stall position around newstage full/empty and simultaneous capture/drain; mixed packet boundary and lastzero-keep groups.
Fault/start/reset/abort/flush at every state combination of ring+stage+output and sameedge commit/verdict; epoch-labelled oracle forbids oldpacket leakage.
Actual missingclear, prematurefree, verdictdelay, payloadmix, lostready and output-unstable mutants; meaningful conservation assertions.
SameCPU6/2GiB mapping and original4ns SS/TT/FF; analyze actual newcritical path, not latency alone.
open_design_decisions: Can final public faultvalid gating be decoupled without weakening immediate cancellation? This may require an explicit registered fault boundary or retaining only externalvalid mask; source proof first.
Where to derive credit/capacity when retirestage accepts zero-keep groups and output isstalled; avoid stale read_any or stalecommit caching.
A cycle-difference in exposed overflow onset caused by addedstage storage is expected but must be a declared strengthened buffering contract; it cannot be claimed exactoldbehavior.
